methodSections.heading: Pear Walnut Salad
steps: Toss arugula and spinach with desired amount of vinaigrette.
Place in a serving bowl and top with crumbled blue cheese, chopped walnuts and sliced pear.

methodSections.heading: Lemon Dijon Dressing
steps: Combine the Dijon, honey, white wine vinegar, lemon juice and garlic in food processor.
Blend and slowly add the canola oil in a thin stream until emulsified. Store in the fridge until ready to serve.
